mapper.select: SELECT LOTNAME FROM PRP_LOT WHERE LOTNAME = #{lotCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME, ID

SELECT mpr.id, mpr.lot_code LotCode, pl.PRODUCTPN AS productCode, --从 prp_lot 表获取产品编码 mpr.equipment_id equipmentId, mpr.workstation_id workstationId, mpr.start_time startTime, mpr.end_time endTime, mpr.status, mpr.pnl_qty pnlQty, mpr.pcs_qty pcsQty, mpr.batch_group_id batchGroupId FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD mpr LEFT JOIN prp_lot pl ON mpr.lot_code = pl.lotname WHERE mpr.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND mpr.record_type = UPPER(#{recordType}) AND mpr.start_time >= #{startTimeFrom} AND mpr.start_time < #{startTimeTo} -- 使用 < 表示小于，避免边界问题 ORDER BY mpr.start_time DESC
SELECT mpr.*, -- 查询主表所有字段 pl.PRODUCTPN AS productCode -- 关联查询产品编码 FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD mpr LEFT JOIN prp_lot pl ON mpr.lot_code = pl.lotname WHERE mpr.id = #{recordId}
SELECT PANELPCS FROM prp_lot WHERE lotname = #{lotCode}
SELECT mpr.*, pl.PRODUCTPN AS productCode FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD mpr LEFT JOIN prp_lot pl ON mpr.lot_code = pl.lotname WHERE mpr.batch_group_id = #{batchGroupId} ORDER BY mpr.start_time, mpr.id

SELECT t.LOT_CODE, SUM(t.PNL_QTY) AS PNL_QTY, SUM(t.PCS_QTY) AS PCS_QTY, NVL(c.cnt,0) AS countQty, lot.TOTALQTY, lot.PANELPCS FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LOT_CODE,COUNT(LOT_CODE) cnt FROM MES_PRODUCTION_RECORD WHERE RECORD_TYPE='REPAIR' GROUP BY LOT_CODE ) c ON t.LOT_CODE = c.LOT_CODE LEFT JOIN PRP_LOT lot ON t.LOT_CODE=lot.LOTNAME WHERE t.LOT_CODE =#{lotCode} AND t.RECORD_TYPE='REPAIR' GROUP BY t.LOT_CODE,c.cnt,lot.TOTALQTY,lot.PANELPCS
